summary: OFAC SDN List update dated 30 September 2026. Treasury designated ten individuals and two Mexican entities as part of the financial network of the Foreign Terrorist Organization / Transnational Criminal Organization Tren de Aragua, following the theft of millions of dollars from U.S. banks. Most designated individuals carry TRX (Tron) digital currency wallet addresses among their identifiers, and two Mexican companies (Enigma Community S. de R.L. de C.V. and Soluciones Integrales Toluca S.A. de C.V.) were designated solely on the basis of being linked to two of the individuals. Separately, the release records delistings unrelated to the Tren de Aragua action: the entity Patraca S.A. de C.V. / Boutique Patraca (narcotics trafficking program), the vessel Maraya (f.k.a. Med Patron, linked to Alwefaq Ltd, Libya program), and individual Tatyana/Tayuana Protopovich (linked to Centuronic Ltd, Belarus program) were removed from the SDN List.

extraction_notes: This is an OFAC SDN List update, not a narrative advisory: most content is designation-list data (names, DOBs, identifiers) rather than a described mechanism. The title's reference to 'Theft of Millions from U.S. Banks' is not elaborated with a laundering mechanism in the body text, so no fraud/mule-account typology was asserted beyond the crypto and front-company patterns the identifiers themselves evidence; CMI010 and SAN004 confidence is accordingly medium, not high. The Belarus (Protopovich/Centuronic Ltd), Libya (Maraya/Med Patron/Alwefaq Ltd) and Counter Narcotics (Patraca S.A. de C.V.) entries are DELISTINGS unconnected to the Tren de Aragua designations and carry no typology evidence in this document; they are included for actor completeness only. None of the named actors resolved against the governed actor register (all returned 'Unresolved'); any actor_ids a human reviewer identifies would need separate confirmation. RIVAS NUNEZ, Juan Gabriel and GALEANO BASURTO, Aslhy Javier are not shown with digital currency addresses in the source text, unlike the other eight Tren de Aragua individuals.
